opennyai_summary.final__decision:
In this petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has prayed to issue a writ of mandamus to recompute the amount of compensation under the award n o .
The respondents are directed to recalculate compensation and other statutory benefits as prayed for by applying the multiplying Factor - 2 in light of the decision in case of Dhiraj Ambalal Patel (supra) after verifying the details of each land.
The entire exercise shall be completed within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of the writ of the order of this court.
5. In view of the above order passed and considering the awards in question and the survey numbers so stated in the awards for which recomputation is sought and in light of the statement made by Ms.
Shah , learned AGP that admittedly in case of the awards in question the multiplying factor-2 is applicable, the petition is allowed.
The respondents are directed to recalculate compensation and other statutory benefits as prayed for by applying the multiplying Factor - 2 C/SCA/902/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 in light of the decision in case of Dhiraj Ambalal Patel (supra) after verifying the details of each land.
The entire exercise shall be completed within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of the writ of the order of this court.
Rule is made absolute.
